components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast authoritative emerald button for calls and submissions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary, #047857); color: #ffffff; font: 600 0.9rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-light, #059669); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #047857; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Calm, architectural secondary button with crisp border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--text-primary, #090d16); font: 600 0.9rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #047857; background: #ecfdf5; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #047857; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Crisp white input field on subtle section background.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.45rem; color: var(--text-primary, #090d16); font: 600 0.85rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--text-primary, #090d16); font: 400 0.95rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #047857; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.15); }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Architectural white card with subtle diffuse elevation and hairline border.
components.html:
Elektrische hulp

components.css: .ds-service-card { display: grid; gap: 0.65rem; padding: 1.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); border-radius: 16px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--text-primary, #090d16); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04), 0 10px 24px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06); transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-service-card span { color: #047857; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-service-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.15rem; color: #090d16; } .ds-service-card p { margin: 0; color: #475569; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.3); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05), 0 20px 40px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); } .ds-service-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #047857; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Header
components.description: Semi-opaque white navigation bar with hairline border and emerald active route indicator.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 58px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 0.8rem 0.4rem; color: #475569; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; background: #047857; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #090d16; } .ds-nav a:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #047857; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Google Proof Rail
components.description: Luminous white trust console: authentic rating, manually swipeable reviews and official Google Maps link.
components.html:
4,9/5 op Google12 van 13 zijn vijf sterren

components.css: .ds-proof { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(210px,.78fr) minmax(0,1.35fr) minmax(190px,.66fr); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-top: 2px solid #047857; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #090d16; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04), 0 10px 24px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06); } .ds-proof-rating, .ds-proof figure, .ds-proof a { min-width: 0; padding: 1.25rem 1.4rem; } .ds-proof-rating { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; } .ds-proof-rating strong { font-size: 1.05rem; color: #090d16; } .ds-proof-rating span, .ds-proof figcaption { color: #64748b; font-size: .78rem; } .ds-proof figure { margin: 0; border-inline: 1px solid #e2e8f0; } .ds-proof blockquote { margin: 0 0 .6rem; font-weight: 600; color: #090d16; } .ds-proof a { display: flex; align-items: center; color: #047857; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-proof a:hover { color: #059669; } .ds-proof a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #047857; outline-offset: -3px; } @media (max-width: 768px) { .ds-proof { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-proof figure { border-block: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-inline: 0; } }

narrative.overview:
BenTech Solutions transitions from a dark-mode tech look to an authoritative, editorial light design architecture. The new visual world radiates professional reliability, crisp legibility, and architectural clarity: clean white and slate surfaces, high-contrast ink-slate typography, and a purposeful botanical circuit emerald accent.

This direction deliberately strips away common 'AI slop' tells:
- No dark glowing halos: Replaces neon blur rings with natural, multi-layer diffuse ambient elevation.
- No simulated liveness gimmicks: Replaces decorative pulsing dots with calm, high-contrast operational status tags.
- No decorative kickers: Eliminates redundant label badges above headings, letting typography speak with genuine hierarchical weight.
- No muddy contrast: Establishes rigorous WCAG AAA contrast for body typography (#090d16 on white, secondary #475569), ensuring effortless readability under all ambient lighting conditions.

The signature Google Proof Rail is re-anchored as a pristine architectural white console with a hairline emerald anchor rule, crisp review typography, authentic star ratings, and direct links to the official Google Business Profile.
keyCharacteristics: Crisp architectural white surfaces with high-contrast slate typography.
Calibrated botanical emerald (#047857) providing accessible, high-contrast signals.
Multi-layered diffuse ambient shadows instead of heavy dark blots or neon halos.
A luminous Google Proof Rail console that foregrounds verifiable reputation.
Direct, distinct contact pathways for urgent troubleshooting and planned energy installations.
Factual, situational Dutch copy free from unverified marketing claims.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Emerald is reserved for intentional action, verification, and orientation. It never floods the page as a decorative wash.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own weight without decorative kicker tags above them.

rules.name: The Ambient Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is created through hairline structural boundaries and multi-layer diffuse shadows; zero-offset glowing halos are strictly banned.

rules.name: The Manual Proof Rule
rules.body: The centre review changes only through explicit visitor input; the Proof Rail never autoplays.

dos: **Do** maintain high-contrast legibility: dark obsidian text on clean light surfaces.
**Do** use subtle, multi-layered diffuse ambient shadows instead of heavy dark blots.
**Do** keep emerald as a sharp, deliberate signal for calls-to-action and active states.
**Do** respect the established Dutch copy and authentic Belgian electrical service context.
**Do** preserve semantic landmarks, visible keyboard focus rings, and WCAG AA contrast throughout.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce dark background surfaces or saturated midnight layers.
**Don't** use colored neon glowing box-shadows or text-shadows.
**Don't** add decorative pulsing dots or artificial status animations.
**Don't** place kickers or eyebrow tags above headings.
**Don't** use low-contrast washed-out grays for secondary copy.
**Don't** invent fake credentials, partner logos, certifications, or fictitious founder identities.
